call_plan.frame_estimate_note: 1472 full units at 21 endpoint-inclusive 2-fps frames plus proposed truncated-final-unit counts 12/2/6. The current sampler rejects non-integral half-second durations, so a separately tested/frozen final-unit rule and exact decoded manifest are mandatory before sealing.
call_plan.truncated_final_unit_sampling_rule: For only the three truncated final units, use the source-anchored exact 2-fps targets k/2 such that k/2 <= true unit duration. Never synthesize, repeat, round past the video end, or add an off-grid endpoint. Retain the true unit end only for K3 boundary authority.

checkpoint_loading_overhead.accounting_rule: The 16.097-hour estimate assumes one uninterrupted process and one hash-chained checkpoint-load record per video shard. No fourth load or post-load process restart is permitted under the eventual original approval; either requires a separately sealed continuation request.

hidden_fields: every unrevealed or future authoritative unit label
controller_label_hiding.current_interface_audit: ModelRelativeLabelStore.controller_view accepts caller-supplied unit IDs and returns their labels. It demonstrates queried-only filtering but is not an authorization or causal-reveal boundary and must not be cited as sufficient label hiding.
controller_label_hiding.required_interface: The exhaustive label store is evaluator/reference-only. A distinct capability must reveal a unit label to controller state only after an authenticated durable VERIFY completion for that exact unit; the action selector may see public observations and causally prior verified results, but cannot request arbitrary IDs or read unrevealed labels, future labels, reference event IDs, or reference boundaries.
required_leakage_tests: With public observations and causally revealed VERIFY history fixed, permuting every unrevealed/future oracle label and reference event must leave controller-visible state and the next action unchanged.
An arbitrary unit-ID request without an authenticated completed VERIFY must fail closed.
The full-grid labeling run instantiates no controller and writes exhaustive labels only into evaluator-owned outputs.

cost_estimate.uncertainty_rule: The direct 20 percent result is 19.3165478468 A100 GPU-hours and 19.4 is its conservative upward rounding. It is not permission for retries, reloads, or extra calls; unused margin cannot be repurposed.
cost_estimate.required_cost_shield: Before seal, freeze a hash-chained two-GPU-second ledger for checkpoint loads and calls plus a fail-closed pre-start reservation rule. No model load or call may start if its sealed reservation would exceed the 19.4 A100 GPU-hour eventual approval ceiling; any accounting mismatch triggers the global stop rule.

failure_and_resume_policy.failed_generation: Preserve the ledger event and missing label; do not retry under the original approval. The run becomes incomplete and no authoritative full-grid EventRelation may be published.
failure_and_resume_policy.global_fail_stop: Choose global rather than shard-local stop. After any shard records GENERATION_FAILED, UNCERTAIN_INTERRUPTION, post-load process fault, cost-shield violation, or integrity mismatch, a coordinator prevents every shard from issuing another INFERENCE_STARTED event. Calls already durably started may reach a terminal record and are preserved; no new call may start.
failure_and_resume_policy.parse_failure: Preserve as parse_failure without regeneration or relabeling; K3 treats it as an indeterminate hard barrier.
failure_and_resume_policy.resume: There is no post-model-load restart or resume under the eventual original approval. A future separately reviewed and approved continuation may reuse authenticated accepted records and propose only call slots with no durable INFERENCE_STARTED; a started call lacking a terminal record remains UNCERTAIN_INTERRUPTION and cannot be regenerated unless the new request explicitly authorizes that retry.
failure_and_resume_policy.preload_validation: A validation abort before any durable MODEL_LOAD_STARTED record consumes no model-load/call budget and may be corrected before execution; once any shard starts loading, the three-load/no-restart rule applies globally.
failure_and_resume_policy.unknown: Preserve as unknown without regeneration or negative coercion; K3 may bridge exactly one short unknown under the frozen rule.

requirements: exact decoded frame manifest and source-video hashes
current complete checkpoint rehash before model load
one authenticated execution session per video shard
one global fail-stop coordinator and hash-chained load/cost ledger
hash-chained attempt ledgers joined to every raw record
write-once raw, parsed, runtime, metrics, evidence, and decision artifacts
complete/incomplete finalizer mapping that cannot publish a partial authoritative reference
zero extra, missing, replaced, or silently retried input

k3_eventization.schedule: Only after all 1475 authorized call slots have authenticated accepted raw/parse outcomes with zero missing, generation-failed, or uncertain unit, order units by video/start, materialize each video independently with the frozen K3 adapter, then concatenate deterministically and recompute in reverse input order. Unknown and parse_failure remain explicit outcomes and barriers under the frozen rule.
k3_eventization.time_authority: Only frozen unit boundaries; VLM diagnostic prose is ignored.

output_shards.publication_rule: The three named authoritative deliverables are atomically finalized only after the complete finalizer gate. An incomplete run writes only explicitly INCOMPLETE diagnostic manifests under incomplete_diagnostics and those artifacts are forbidden for downstream scoring, replay, ceiling, headroom, or controller use.

publication_decision_mapping.FULL_GRID_COMPLETE_REFERENCE_PUBLISHED: Exactly 1475 authenticated accepted raw/parse outcomes, no missing/generation-failed/uncertain call, exact manifests and ledgers, deterministic K3 equality, and atomic publication of the three authoritative deliverables.
publication_decision_mapping.FULL_GRID_INCOMPLETE_NO_AUTHORITATIVE_RE: Any missing, generation-failed, uncertain, extra, retried, unauthenticated, cost, or integrity condition; preserve diagnostics but publish no authoritative unit_labels or EventRelation and permit no downstream use.

preexecution_requirements: Implement and test the explicit truncated-final-unit 2-fps rule; prove exact target counts 12/2/6 and no source-frame overrun.
Decode and freeze all 1475 exact frame sets without observing model outputs.
Build exact call, frame, provenance, cost, analyzer, finalizer, and decision manifests.
Implement the evaluator-only label capability and authenticated causal VERIFY reveal boundary; pass arbitrary-request rejection and unrevealed-label permutation tests.
Implement and test the global fail-stop coordinator, exactly-three-load ledger, zero-reload rule, 19.4-hour cost shield, and complete/incomplete atomic publication gate.
Freeze exact Parquet/coverage schemas, row ordering, status vocabulary, and payload/file hashes.
Seal an executable full-grid package with zero retry and exact output paths.
Obtain a new independent GO for that exact seal.
Obtain explicit user approval referencing that exact full-grid seal before any model load.
scope: Proposal only. It authorizes no frame-freeze expansion, model inference, retry, full-grid execution, or downstream experiment.
